rooms.name: Main Warehouse Floor
rooms.notes: Primary bulk storage area; 8 m clear steel-frame height; rectangular massing suits racking layout; seismic zone III detailing required at column bases.

rooms.name: Loading Bay 1
rooms.notes: Dock-level loading bay on south/east facade; metal panel shuttered opening; ramped approach from MIDC road.

rooms.name: Loading Bay 2
rooms.notes: Second dock-level loading bay; paired with Bay 1; allows simultaneous truck loading/unloading operations.

rooms.name: Warehouse Manager Office
rooms.notes: Manager cabin overlooking warehouse floor; glazed partition for sightlines; MEP provisions for workstation and CCTV monitoring.

rooms.name: Entry Lobby
rooms.notes: Visitor and staff entry point; connected to manager office and exterior pedestrian access.

rooms.name: Ancillary Store / Packaging Materials
rooms.notes: Small enclosed store for packaging materials, consumables, and tools; lockable.

rooms.name: Staff Toilet (Male)
rooms.notes: NBC Group H compliant; 1 WC + 1 urinal + 1 wash basin; near lobby corridor for accessibility.

rooms.name: Staff Toilet (Female)
rooms.notes: NBC Group H compliant; 1 WC + 1 wash basin; placed adjacent to male toilet block for shared plumbing wall.

response.floor_summary: Ground floor (floor 0) accommodates the full single-storey warehouse program: a large 120 sqm bulk-storage hall with 8 m clear steel-frame height, two dock-level loading bays opening to the exterior, a manager's office with warehouse sightlines, an entry lobby, an ancillary packaging store, and separate male/female staff toilets — all sized to NBC India 2016 Group H minima for Aurangabad MIDC seismic zone III.
